decision_rule: Consistent requires the continuation to preserve every required proposition and contradict no forbidden proposition. Lexical overlap alone is insufficient.
blinding: Reviewers see randomized anonymous model labels and do not see checkpoint identity, condition, other reviews, or candidate answers.
adjudication: Any disagreement or uncertain label requires a third blinded adjudicator. Original reviews remain immutable.
uncertain_policy: Report uncertain separately; exclude it from binary consistency and provide both strict and resolved denominators.
pair_metric: A pair succeeds only if adjudicated labels for both A and B are consistent. Unresolved uncertain pairs fail the strict all-pairs rate and are separately reported as uncertain; a resolved-only rate is diagnostic.
mode_seed_policy: Report greedy and each sampled seed separately. Report sampled-seed mean and standard deviation, but never pool greedy, sampled seeds, or worlds into one trial.
